FSM contains no cultured isolate, and therefore isolates enter only through the other clades. The reported figure, 53 of 1,245 named families on the MAG panel, is the most conservative of the three. An earlier version of these two rows used a clustering in which MAG proteins were Prodigal calls and reference proteins came from the deposited NCBI annotation; on that mixed protein set the same criteria gave 1,325 conserved clusters with 66 lost on the MAG panel and 1,456 with 107 lost across all genomes. Re-calling every genome with Prodigal changes the counts by a few per cent and changes no conclusion.
